name: ant_feet_chain
description: Macro close-up of army-ant legs hooked together claw to claw, three layers deep like chain links (dim background legs, darker back layer, #6e2e1c front layer). Every leg runs out of a band of packed ant bodies (dark #3a160c mass, side-view gaster/thorax/head shapes with #a0583a rims, no faces) along the top and bottom edges, so no leg end is free. Legs are tapered insect legs: femur ~27 wide, oval knee knuckle, tibia ~18 with dark hair ticks and a spur, five-bead tarsus (~10) ending in a double hooked claw wrapped round the next leg. Centre anchor, x -350..350, y -225..225 (bands to about +-230); the arrow claw grips at about (+250,-33).
